results.title: The Cost of Heaven
results.overview: On the cusp of his 50th birthday, Nacer Belkacem dreams of a better life. Yet, over the years, he has built himself an enviable position in the eyes of all: a loving family man, a happy husband, a model employee, and a respected citizen in his community. But the veneer is cracking. Beneath a seemingly perfect surface, Nacer has racked up expenses, made questionable investments, and is up to his neck in debt. On the brink of ruin, he devises a desperate plan to try to pull himself out of the water. You only have one life to earn your way to heaven...

results.title: Another Story
results.overview: The lives of four characters collide during a tragic robbery at a tobacco shop.  Alberto is the owner of the tobacco shop. The night before the robbery, his wife, Marta, discovers that he has cheated on her. He tries to convince her to stay, but she leaves.  Laura is the shop assistant and Alberto’s lover. She believes she can finally be with him, but the conversation she has been waiting for is interrupted by the robbery.  Javier is a customer at the tobacco shop who owes money to a dealer. He tries to win it in a poker game the night before the robbery.  Diego lives with his seriously ill father. Their financial situation forces Diego to rob the tobacco shop.

results.title: NJPW Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 - Day 4
results.original_title: NJPW Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 - Day 4
results.overview: The fourth night of Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on April 1, 2026, at Nagano Prefectural Budokan in Saku, Nagano, Japan.

results.title: Kat Crime: Tales of the Occult
results.original_title: Kat Crime: Tales of the Occult
results.overview: KAT CRIME: TALES OF THE OCCULT follows Kat, the driven host of a struggling true-crime podcast, who drags her influencer friend Deana into a dangerous investigation involving a suspected witch coven accused of murder.

results.title: Aurora
results.overview: Stranded in the farthest reaches of space, the sole survivor of a catastrophic accident faces a divine reckoning he never imagined.

results.title: ROH: Death Before Dishonor 2026
results.overview: The 2026 Death Before Dishonor was an professional wrestling live streaming event produced by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH). It was the 23rd Death Before Dishonor event and took place on Friday, August 21, 2026, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The show was broadcast on both HonorClub and MyAEW (for international subscribers).

results.title: NJPW Wrestling Redzone in Hiroshima 2026
results.overview: Wrestling Redzone in Hiroshima 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on April 25, 2026, at Hiroshima Sun Plaza in Hiroshima, Japan. The show featured a match for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Championships and was headlined by Knockout Brothers (OSKAR & Yuto-Ice) (c) vs. Bishamon (Hirooki Goto & YOSHI-HASHI) for the IWGP Tag Team Championships.

results.title: TALK SHOW
results.overview: Talk Show is the final film in Jordan Strafer’s Loophole trilogy. The narrative unfolds across two periods of time: the turn of the millennium, shot in color, and the afterlife, shot in black and white. Structured around a talk show, the work examines 1990s celebrity culture, violence against women, and justice as televised spectacle. Its screenplay draws on sources ranging from news footage to self-help media, blending historical fact with fiction. [Overview courtesy of The Whitney]

results.title: Garv
results.overview: Garv's only trying to get ahead. Fresh into a new life in Melbourne, he's landed a decent job, a shot at succes, and a workplace that's anything but welcoming. As the cracks begin to show, a few harmless jokes turn into something harder to ignore. But when speaking up makes him the problem, Garv's forced to confront an uncomfortable truth; sometimes, fitting in comes at a cost.

results.title: Handy Girl
results.overview: An urgent and punk cinematic diary where documentary and fiction collide. Guided by her handycam, a Buenos Aires underground actress and mother captures her daily fight for self-determination, turning low-fi filmmaking into political and artistic resistance.

results.title: Anna VS the Kids
results.overview: Anna, a friendly but reclusive fortysomething, harbors an unusual phobia: she’s terrified of children. When she reconnects with Alexandre, her ex-boyfriend she never stopped loving, she thinks she’s finally found happiness… until she discovers he has two kids. When circumstances force her to care for them alone, a panicked Anna reluctantly agrees. Between ridiculous rules and absurd situations, this forced living arrangement might just change everything… for worse, but also for better.

results.title: Serena
results.overview: Desperate to launch her company into the future with resounding success, a CEO commissions tech engineer Holly  to build her an AI model. However, before being implemented it must be tested. Down-on-his-luck and funds, former rock star, Chris Sadowsky, is asked to be one of the testers — with devastating repercussions.

results.title: Filipiñana
results.overview: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

results.title: Over the Threshold
results.overview: Teenagers Danijela and Branko, newlyweds find themselves overwhelmed by wedding traditions. When they feel they can no longer breathe, they decide to run away from their own wedding party into the cold night.

results.title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker
results.original_title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker
results.overview: Ainsley McGregor thought craft markets and book clubs, not corpses, would define her new life back home in Sweet River. That is until a beloved member of the book club raises a cold case involving her late husband who was found murdered over his rare antique watch. Ainsley springs into action to untangle a web of small town secrets before the killer winds the clock down on the next victim.

results.title: The Enigma of Franca Farmín
results.overview: Franca Farmín, a young aspiring YouTuber obsessed with documenting paranormal phenomena, travels to the remote Laguna del Olvido, convinced she can capture the unknown on camera and uncover a mystery that could make her go viral. Franca sets out in search of a legend?and becomes one.

results.title: Ruki Vverh! 2
results.overview: Thirty years after the story of the band Ruki Vverkh! began, Sergey Zhukov together with his children revisits memories of his youth: his first love, his first big dreams, friendship, family, and the journey to the stage.

results.title: Union Town
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of New York City, the film follows delivery industry workers as they take on some of the world s most powerful corporate giants, touching on the challenges, joys and human elements that make this movement possible.
